init_hook: echo '  ./scripts/dev-local.sh   - Start local Supabase + switch to local config'
echo '  supabase start           - Start local Supabase'
echo '  supabase stop            - Stop local Supabase'
echo '  supabase db reset        - Reset local database'
echo '  open http://127.0.0.1:54423  - Open Supabase Studio'
echo '📦 App Commands (when you add package.json):'
echo '  npm run dev              - Start development server'
echo '  npm run build            - Build for production'
echo '📖 Read DEVELOPMENT.md for detailed setup guide'
